clips.title: The story
paras: Furen Longbeard is a master dwarven armorer stationed within Stormwind City's bustling Dwarven District. Apprenticed under the renowned smith Grimand Elmore, he specializes in crafting heavy protective gear and sturdy mail for seasoned defenders of the Alliance. Warriors across the kingdom seek out his metallurgical expertise to forge specialized, battle-ready armor.

Furen Longbeard plies his craft far from the great forges of Ironforge, making his home instead among the cobblestones and soot of Stormwind's Dwarven District. Like many of his kin, Furen brought traditional dwarven metallurgy south to support the rebuilding and defense of the kingdom. Working amidst blazing hearths and clanging anvils, he maintains strong ties with other artisans throughout the city and beyond.
